title: Ali Zafar releases first Shina language song 'Kare Kare' - MM News
text: The song titled "Kare Kare" highlights the beauty, traditions, and cultural colors of Gilgit-Baltistan. Alongside Ali Zafar, the music video features local singer Salman Pars, who also composed the track. The video was directed and produced by Ali Zafar in collaboration with Ali Mustafa, while the lyrics were penned by Zafar Waqar Taj.

title: Kare Kare Recipe - Panlasang Pinoy
text: Kare Kare is a Filipino oxtail stew in a thick peanut sauce, served with rice and a small bowl of bagoong alamang on the side. The sauce in this Kare Kare recipe is built from ground peanuts, a little peanut butter, and toasted ground rice. Annatto seeds give it that orange color.
